entries.definition: A written opinion saying if something is good or bad
entries.sentence: Before booking a hotel room, I always read online customer reviews.

entries.definition: Perfect or the best possible choice
entries.sentence: Sunny weather with a light breeze is ideal for a picnic in the park.

entries.definition: Unluckily; used to share bad or sad news
entries.sentence: I wanted to join you for dinner, but unfortunately, I have to work late tonight.

entries.definition: A sign, sound, or action that tells someone to do something
entries.sentence: She raised her hand as a signal for the driver to stop.

entries.definition: Something that causes a problem or makes things harder
entries.sentence: One disadvantage of living far away is the long travel time.
The chocolate cake at the bakery tasted fantastic.

entries.definition: The people who work for a business or company
entries.sentence: The hotel staff was friendly and helped us with our luggage.

entries.definition: A building, room, or equipment built for a specific purpose
entries.sentence: The university campus offers excellent athletic facilities, including a pool and a gym.

entries.definition: A big meeting where people gather to talk about a topic
entries.sentence: Doctors from around the world gathered for the annual medical conference.

entries.definition: Making you feel relaxed and physically at ease
entries.sentence: This soft armchair is very comfortable to sit in while reading.
The subway station gets extremely crowded during peak commute hours.

entries.definition: To suggest something because you think it is good
entries.sentence: Can you recommend a good Italian restaurant nearby?
The new coffee shop is in a convenient location right next to the train station.

entries.definition: Not nice or pretty to look at
entries.sentence: The old, empty building looked very unattractive.
